The hidden worker wins `claim.json` using exclusive create, validates the one-shot capability, unlinks both input files, marks `claimReady`, acquires provider admission, launches the private provider adapter and periodically advances `workerHeartbeatAt`. Provider output updates a separate `lastProviderProgressAt` only when observable; unsupported observability is represented as `unobservable`, never fabricated.

A terminal is created exclusively and exactly once. It records outcome, timing, exit/timeout/cancel reason, provider identity, spec/profile binding digests, evidence journal digest, process cleanup facts, residual process state and an independent `replacementSafe`. Repeated status/cancel/attach calls first acquire a short `reconcile.lock`, re-read facts, and materialize terminal truth for deadline expiry or authoritative worker/provider death.
